set.typical_award_size: Round 2 (NOFA issued March 4, 2026, due April 1, 2026): up to $5,000,000 in loans. Loan size up to 10% of project cost. Affordable projects: subordinate or senior loan at 3% interest, interest only during construction and up to 36 months after conversion, then amortizing, up to 18-year combined term, sized at minimum 1.05 combined DSC. Market rate or middle income: construction loan at senior rate plus 1% (4% floor), up to 3 years; permanent loan at first-position rate plus 1% (4% floor), up to 10 years. 1% origination fee ($10,000 minimum); commitments expire 18 months after Board approval. Round 1 (December 21, 2021 NOFA) awards: Acme Family Apartments $800,000, Aviara $2,400,000, Casa Roseland $4,200,000, 420 Mendocino Avenue $7,000,000, Pullman Lofts $2,300,000 (reduced to $1,300,000), South Park Commons $4,000,000.
